title: A units or Lp(a)-unit change mid-run is not a save-all stop cause; every later values report repeats the refusal
evidence: Done 2026-11-27 (root fix R23 closed, superseded by the shared upload engine): the per-value save-all loop is gone. The phone saves an upload in one call, ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore+Uploads.swift:13-46 (saveUpload -> engine.uploadSave), and a refusal comes back once for the whole upload. LabReportSave.swift and its stop() were deleted in 7f1fb856c (PR 1913, 2026-11-20). Open line: no test pins an upload Save when the record's units change mid-review (a coverage gap, not a known fault). Was: LabReportSave.swift:203 stop() checked only the erase and an unreadable record; RecordStore.swift:409 and :413 refused each later save the same way. Adversary F3 on save all (US-52 AC8b), 2026-11-11
